Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
not planning to keep working on it, just post here whoever finds it interesting can play with it

Code at: https://github.com/ZeroXPatch/Projects-for-Nexus-Mod


[b][color=#ffff00]What this tool does
[/color][/b]
[b]Stardew Valley – Safe Mode Loader[/b] is an external helper for SMAPI players.


It lets you:
[list]
[*][b]Turn on a “Safe Mode”[/b] where [i]only[/i] selected mods are active.
[*][b]Automatically move all other mods into a backup folder[/b] (no deleting, just temporarily moved).
[*][b]Restore everything with one click[/b] when you’re done testing.
[*][b]Save & load mod profiles[/b] (e.g. “Multiplayer Setup”, “Bug Test”, “Vanilla+”, etc.).
[*][b]Launch the game/SMAPI directly[/b] from the tool.
[*][b]Use the interface in multiple languages[/b] (English, 简体中文, Русский, Português BR).
[/list]It never edits your mod files – it just moves entire mod folders in and out of the [code]Mods[/code] directory and remembers what it did in a state file.
[line]When it’s usefulThis tool helps with:
[list]
[*][b]Fixing crashes & conflicts[/b]
Turn on safe mode with just a few mods at a time to find which mod is causing issues.[*][b]Testing new mods or modpacks[/b]
Create a profile that only has the mods you’re currently developing or testing.[*][b]Playing different “setups”[/b]
For example:[list]
[*]“Solo Farm” profile
[*]“Multiplayer” profile
[*]“Performance / Low Mods” profile
[/list][*][b]Keeping your Mods folder clean[/b]
Temporarily hide big mod sets without uninstalling them.[/list][line]How Safe Mode works (behind the scenes)[list=1]
[*]You choose your [b]Mods folder[/b] and [b]game/SMAPI executable[/b].

[*]The app lists every [b]mod folder[/b] inside [code]Mods[/code] as a checkbox.

[*]You [b]check the mods you want to keep enabled[/b].

[*]Click [b]“Enable Safe Mode with Selected Mods”[/b]:
[list]
[*]The app creates a timestamped backup folder next to your [code]Mods[/code] folder
(e.g. [code]Mods_backup_safe_mode_20250101_123456[/code]).[*]Every [i]unchecked[/i] mod folder is moved into that backup folder.
[*]Only the [b]checked[/b] mods remain in [code]Mods[/code].
[*]It remembers which mods were kept and where the backup is.
[/list]
[*]When you’re done, click [b]“Restore All Mods”[/b]:
[list]
[*]All backup mod folders are moved back into [code]Mods[/code].
[*]Safe mode is turned off.
[/list]
[/list]If Safe Mode is already active and you try to enable it again, the tool will [b]ask for confirmation[/b], restore the previous safe mode first, and then apply the new setup.
[line]Profiles (saved mod setups)Profiles are just [b]named lists of mod folders[/b] to keep enabled.
[list]
[*]A profile stores: [code]"profile name" → [list of enabled mod folder names][/code]
[*]Profiles are saved into the config JSON ([code]safe_mode_config.json[/code]) and reloaded when you open the app again.
[/list]You can quickly switch between mod setups by loading a profile, then enabling safe mode.
[line]Multi-language supportYou can switch the UI language at any time:
[list]
[*][b]English (EN)[/b]
[*][b]简体中文 (ZH)[/b]
[*][b]Русский (RU)[/b]
[*][b]Português (Brasil) (PT_BR)[/b]
[/list]All labels, button texts, and messages use the selected language (error popups use that language too, except for very low-level save errors).
[line]UI and button explanationsTop right – Language[list]
[*][b]Language: [Combo box][/b]
Choose the interface language.Changing it immediately updates all texts and is saved for next time.[/list][line]Mods Folder (SMAPI Mods)[quote]Frame label: [b]“Mods Folder (SMAPI Mods)”[/b][/quote][list]
[*][b]Text field[/b]
Shows the path to your [code]Mods[/code] folder.[*][b]Browse…[/b]
Opens a folder picker.Sets the selected path as your mods folder, saves it, and refreshes the mod list.[/list][line]Game / SMAPI Executable[quote]Frame label: [b]“Game / SMAPI Executable”[/b][/quote][list]
[*][b]Text field[/b]
Path to the executable you use to start Stardew (usually the SMAPI [code].exe[/code]).[*][b]Browse…[/b]
Opens a file picker (filters for [code].exe[/code] by default).Saves the selected file path. Required for the “Launch Game” button to work.[/list][line]Profiles (Safe Setups)[quote]Frame label: [b]“Profiles (Safe Setups)”[/b][/quote]Row 1 – Existing profiles[list]
[*][b]Profile:[/b]
Label next to the profile dropdown.[*][b]Profile dropdown (combo box)[/b]
Shows all saved profile names (sorted). Choose which setup you want to work with.[*][b]Load Selection[/b]
[list]
[*]Reads the selected profile.
[*]Checks the boxes for all mods that belong to that profile.
[*]Any mod in the profile that [b]isn’t present[/b] in the Mods folder is reported in a warning popup.
[/list][*][b]Delete[/b]
[list]
[*]Deletes the selected profile after a confirmation popup.
[*]Updates the dropdown and saves the config.
[/list][/list]Row 2 – Save current selection[list]
[*][b]“Save current selection as:” + Text field[/b]
Enter a new profile name here.[*][b]Save Profile[/b]
[list]
[*]Takes all currently [b]checked[/b] mods in the list.
[*]If no mods are checked: shows a warning.
[*]If a profile with that name already exists: asks if you want to overwrite it.
[*]Saves the profile and shows a confirmation popup with the number of mods stored.
[/list][/list][line]Mods list (Available Mods)[quote]Frame label: [b]“Available Mods (check to keep enabled)”[/b][/quote]This is a scrollable list of all [b]mod folders[/b] inside the selected Mods directory.
[list]
[*]Each mod folder appears as a [b]checkbox[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Checked[/b] = this mod will be [b]kept in the Mods folder[/b] when enabling Safe Mode.
[*][b]Unchecked[/b] = this mod will be [b]moved to the backup[/b] when enabling Safe Mode.
[/list][/list]Select / Deselect All[list]
[*][b]“Select / Deselect All” checkbox[/b]
[list]
[*]When you toggle it:
[list]
[*]ON = checks all mods in the list.
[*]OFF = unchecks all mods.
[/list][*]It also updates automatically when you manually check/uncheck all mods.
[/list][/list][line]Main buttons (bottom center)Enable "Safe Mode" with Selected Mods[list]
[*]Validates that:
[list]
[*]Mods folder path is set and exists.
[*]At least one mod is checked.
[/list][*]If a safe mode is already active:
[list]
[*]Asks if you want to disable the previous one and restore first.
[/list][*]Creates a new backup folder and moves [b]all unchecked[/b] mod folders there.
[*]Saves the new state:
[list]
[*]Safe mode ON
[*]Backup folder path
[*]Selected mods
[*]Active profile name (if any)
[/list][*]Refreshes the list to show only the remaining mods.
[*]Shows a popup summarizing:
[list]
[*]Active profile name (or “Manual” if none)
[*]How many mods are active
[*]Backup location
[/list][/list]Restore All Mods[list]
[*]Only works when [b]Safe Mode is active[/b].
[*]Moves [b]all mods from the backup folder back into the Mods folder[/b].
[*]Deletes the backup folder if it’s empty.
[*]Resets the internal state (Safe Mode OFF).
[*]Refreshes the mod list and updates the status bar.
[*]If some mods couldn’t be moved back (e.g. permission issues), it shows a warning listing them.
[/list]Launch Game in Current Mode[list]
[*]Starts the game using the [b]Game / SMAPI executable[/b] you selected.
[*]Uses its folder as the working directory.
[*]If the executable isn’t set or doesn’t exist, shows an error popup.
[/list][line]Bottom left – Refresh Mod List[list]
[*][b]Refresh[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-scans the Mods folder.
[*]Rebuilds the checkbox list.
[*]Updates the status bar with the number of mods found.
[*]Does [b]not[/b] change your Safe Mode state (just reloads what’s visible).
[/list][/list][line]Status bar (bottom)Shows various messages such as:
[list]
[*][b]“Ready.”[/b] when idle.
[*][b]“No mods found in the selected Mods folder.”[/b]
[*][b]“Found X mod(s).”[/b] after scanning.
[*][b]“Normal mode. All mods should be active.”[/b] when safe mode is off.
[*][b]“SAFE MODE ACTIVE (ProfileName): ... Backup: [path]”[/b] when safe mode is on.
[/list]This text is localized to the selected language.
[line]Files created[list]
[*][b][code]safe_mode_config.json[/code][/b]
[list]
[*]Saves:
[list]
[*]Mods folder path
[*]Game executable path
[*]Profiles
[*]Selected language
[/list][/list][*][b][code]safe_mode_state.json[/code][/b]
[list]
[*]Saves:
[list]
[*]Whether Safe Mode is currently active
[*]Backup folder path
[*]Which mods are selected
[*]Which profile (if any) was used
[/list][/list][/list]These let the tool remember your settings between runs and keep track of Safe Mode status.
